mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a garage apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting estimates for a garage apartment, gather essential property documents and define your primary goals for the space. Locate your property survey to check boundary lines, easements, and setback requirements, and review any homeowner association guidelines regarding secondary residences. It is also helpful to determine whether the space will accommodate aging parents, adult children, or guests, as multigenerational living often requires zero-entry walk-in showers and wider doorways. Finally, document your existing electrical panel capacity and note where sewer and water mains access your property, which helps contractors assess utility tie-in requirements during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, review HOA rules, determine intended uses like accessibility needs, and note your electrical panel capacity and main utility locations.
